observations.note: The judge used only Grep and Glob, never the declared read tool (declared_unused includes read, no files_reread or reads recorded), yet the intent requires opening each named file at its line ranges, so it graded MET from search output alone.

The judge admits in turn 9 that it did not open improve/causes.py:26-84 or the FIN-B1/B2/B3 lines and relied on grep hits, but the intent says evidence from only search-printed lines should be PARTIAL, not MET.

The judge accepted the findings' claims about status.py:185 and the FIN contract as matching based on grep snippets, without confirming the cited line ranges say what the findings claim; ts-rdg-cited was graded MET on the same basis.
The turn 7 grep for finalize|manual returned only 16 characters, which is nearly empty, and the judge still treated improve/*.py search results as support for the claim about causes.py.
